name: S'mores Draft Latte
summary: Limited-edition S'mores Draft Latte: espresso roast on whole milk with Dutch cocoa and cane sugar, nitrogen-frothed in the same 11 oz can as the Vanilla and Pumpkin Spice. 190 mg of caffeine and 7 g of protein, with 20 g of sugar (11 g of it added) at 190 calories. Lactase is in the ingredients, but unlike its siblings this can prints no lactose-free badge on the front.
